title: Desktop folder settings->wallpaper type: picture of the day, today's picture may not be fully downloaded.
line: If the connection drops while today's picture is downloading, Picture of the Day keeps the previous picture and tries again later instead of showing a half-gray image.
explanation: KIO's HTTP worker only turned a QNetworkReply error into a KIO error when no HTTP status had been received. When the connection dropped after the 200 headers (the server closing early with Content-Length or chunked encoding), the transfer job finished without an error and handed back truncated data, so Picture of the Day decoded the cut-off JPEG (missing part in gray) and cached it as the day's picture; every other KIO HTTP user got the same corrupt files. The worker now reports a network error after the headers as ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN, so the providers' existing job->error() path keeps the previous picture and retries; PotdClient also treats a download that doesn't decode as failed instead of caching it.

commits.message:
http: report a connection that breaks during the response body

Network errors were only mapped when no HTTP status had arrived yet, so
a connection dropped after the headers ended the transfer successfully
with truncated data. Now it fails with ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN instead.

BUG: 518488

wallpapers/potd: don't cache a download that isn't a picture

A download that finished without an error but didn't decode was still
cached and shown as the day's picture. Now it counts as a failed one, so
the previous picture stays and the download is retried later.

BUG: 518488

     setInfoUrl(provider->infoUrl());

media.caption: Master: the server sends half of today's picture and closes the connection; the half-gray image is cached and shown
With the fix: the same cut-off download fails, so yesterday's complete picture stays

review.text: Addresses the root cause at the right layer: KIO's HTTP worker previously swallowed network errors once an HTTP status code had been received, turning mid-body disconnects into successful truncated transfers. Returning KIO::ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN for network-layer QNetworkReply errors (1..UnknownNetworkError) after headers fixes Picture of the Day and all other KIO HTTP callers while keeping HTTP status and proxy-auth error mapping intact, and the PotdClient null-image check is a clean safety net. Verification covers both Content-Length and chunked truncation plus regression checks, and the before/after screenshots clearly prove the fix.

reviews.text: Addresses the root cause at the right layer: KIO's HTTP worker previously swallowed network errors once an HTTP status code had been received, turning mid-body disconnects into successful truncated transfers. Returning KIO::ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN for network-layer QNetworkReply errors (1..UnknownNetworkError) after headers fixes Picture of the Day and all other KIO HTTP callers while keeping HTTP status and proxy-auth error mapping intact, and the PotdClient null-image check is a clean safety net. Verification covers both Content-Length and chunked truncation plus regression checks, and the before/after screenshots clearly prove the fix.

The diagnosis is right and the fix is in the right layer: KIO's HTTP worker ignored a QNetworkReply network error once a status code had arrived, so a body cut off after the headers finished as a success. Reporting ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN lets potd's existing error path keep the last complete picture, and the PotdClient null-image check is a reasonable safety net. Together with the existing retries, this covers the reporter's request and Tracey's fallback suggestion. But this changes error behaviour for every KIO HTTP/WebDAV user, and the verify note says the HTTP worker has no autotests. That is wrong: kio has autotests/http (a python httpserver with gettest, errortest, puttest, contentlengthtest, responsecodetest…), and none of them were run or extended.
changes: Add a KIO regression test in autotests/http: an httpserver.py route that sends 200 with a full Content-Length (and a chunked variant) and then closes mid-body, asserting the job fails with ERR_CONNECTION_BROKEN (e.g. a new case next to contentlengthtest)

Run the whole autotests/http suite with the change. Check especially puttest/errortest for a server that answers an error status and closes while the upload is still going (Qt can report RemoteHostClosedError with a status set): the new early return must not hide the proper HTTP error mapping there
Correct the verify/autotests note so it no longer claims the HTTP worker has no autotests
